notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello Trade Tycoons! 👋
With this new update, we’ve made some fixes to improve your gameplay experience:

📱 Phone issue fixed. It now works more stably.
🍕 Pizza mission now ends automatically. No more task stuck problems.
🎨 UI quality improved. Cleaner and clearer interface experience.
🚶 Motion blur while moving has been fixed. Enjoy smoother gameplay.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
🔹 Added French, Spanish, and German languages.
🔹 Improved and adjusted game sounds.
🔹 New items added to the game.
🔹 General balance adjustments made.

notes.title: Trade Tycoon Life Simulator - Update Notes
notes.content:
Fixed lighting balance issues in the game.

Added mouse sensitivity setting to the options menu.

Updated camera field of view (POV).

Simplified the mini-map and world map for a smoother experience.

Adjusted some sound effects.

Shortened the tutorial system and spread it across different areas of the game.

Corrected naming errors on various objects.

Added LED lights to the shop sign to indicate when it is open. In the warehouse, the “Open” symbol now appears in green or red.

Optimized small objects in the city to improve performance.

notes.title: 📅 Regular Updates – Always Fresh!
notes.content:
New Features:
Auction system added. You can participate in auctions every day between 16:00 and 17:00.
Improvements:
UI sounds updated.

Customer arrival rate balanced.
Bug Fixes:
Shop dirtiness issue fixed.

Lag issue when opening the map fixed.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559469/35e256411039b7b57a6cf943122e76c984df17dd.png"]

notes.title: 🍔 REGULAR UPDATE - Fill Your Stomach, Forget the Bugs!
notes.content:
Hey trader buddy! The shop, the city, the market… The game is growing and we’re catching bugs like pros! Here's what's new:

🛠️ What’s Fixed and Added?

Annoying UI bugs got caught and removed, the interface is smoother now.

A brand new Market opened in the city! Hungry? Tired? You know where to go.

Fish prices were crazy like the stock market… now they are fair and stable.

The save problem is fixed, your progress won't disappear anymore.

Product average price was playing hide and seek… It’s visible again.

Shop interior redesigned — no more maze, it's clean and easy to use.

Language issues have been hunted down and fixed.

🎣 Bottom line: Eat well, grow your shop, catch fish… We’ll keep updating! Leave a comment — or next time, we might put YOU on the shop shelf! 😄

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559469/d6002fc6db4378fb6db15b9d93e73e8a3446186e.png"]

notes.title: Update is Live!
notes.content:
Portuguese language added.

Tutorial completely revamped for easier understanding.

Nightclub updated to be more vibrant and immersive.

Character customization is here! (Clothing options coming soon.)

Graphics and optimization improvements made for smoother gameplay.

Motorcycle no longer falls over, improved driving experience.

New sound effects added to enhance atmosphere.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Trade Tycoon Life Simulator - Update Notes
notes.content:
New Features:

Outline effect added to items. Now it’s easier to spot interactable objects around you.

Scratch card (Kazı Kazan) system introduced. Try your luck and win small rewards!

Computer interface completely revamped. More user-friendly, organized, and smoother to use.

Settings menu expanded. Added more options especially for graphics and sound settings.

Trash system added. Garbage will accumulate in your shop over time—keep it clean to maintain appearance and customer satisfaction.

New day-night cycle and sky system implemented. The game world feels more alive and realistic than ever.

Improvements and Optimizations:

Lighting system optimized. Balanced visual quality and performance to provide more natural lighting.

notes.content:

notes.title: English – Trade Tycoon: Life Simulator v0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Tycoons!
Update v0.2 brings major changes and improvements to your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

🔧 General Improvements
All UI elements have been redesigned for a modern and user-friendly experience.

The main menu has been updated.

Cursor hiding issues have been fixed.

Energy depletion bug has been resolved.

🏙️ City Updates
Buildings and environment models in the city have been improved.

A pet has been added to the city – keep an eye out!

🏪 Shop & Structures
All shop textures have been completely replaced.

Shop structure redesigned for a more player-focused experience.

🚗 New Content
New vehicles added to the game.

New map: race track with night races!

A coin flip NPC has been added – try your luck!

📘 Tutorial Improvements
The tutorial is now smoother and easier to follow.

Enjoy the update and keep the feedback coming! 🚀
